name: The Missing Heirloom
description: Bandits robbed the Mayor's coach on the Merchant's Highway and took his family's signet ring. He wants it back, quietly.

start_condition.start_hint: Speak with Mayor Thomas in the center of Goldenhaven.

stages.description: Speak with Mayor Thomas about the theft.
The robbers were seen holed up in the old watchtower on the Merchant's Highway.
Deal with the bandits holding the tower.

objectives.description: Defeat the bandits guarding the tower.

stages.description: The ring is not on them. Bandits hide their best takings somewhere above the fire.

objectives.description: Find the hidden compartment on the tower's upper floor.

stages.description: Return the ring to Mayor Thomas.

offer.text: Troubled. Yes. Bandits stopped my coach on the Merchant's Highway three nights ago. They took my purse, which I can bear, and my grandfather's signet ring, which I cannot. Every mayor of this city has worn it. I would rather the Merchant Princes didn't hear I'd lost it.

where.label: Where did they go?
where.text: The coachman says they rode for the old watchtower, west along the highway. Nobody has manned it in forty years. Apparently somebody does now.

accept.label: I'll get your ring back.
accept.text: Thank you. Discreetly, if you can manage it. The family has a ring of its own for whoever brings the signet home: an old ward, still good.

decline.label: Not right now.
decline.text: I understand. If you change your mind, I will still be here, trying not to look at my bare hand.

going.label: I'm on my way to the watchtower.
going.text: West along the Merchant's Highway. Do be careful.

cleared.label: Bandits hold the tower.
cleared.text: Then they'll have it on them, or near them. Bandits are not imaginative people.

searching.label: The bandits are dealt with, but no ring.
searching.text: They'll have hidden it. Up high, where they sleep, if I know thieves. Look for a loose board.

after.text: Back where it belongs, and nobody the wiser. Wear the other one in good health. It kept my grandmother alive through a war.
